label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee/surprise feast in the town hall great hall for day 1 at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves and eight installed lanterns, and arrangements to bring the mayor there without revealing the celebration. Baker knowingly supplied paid bread and oven access while agreeing to confidentiality. The mayor was told of a hospitality presentation and accepted its appointment, but the record does not show him being told of the secret jubilee or feast preparations. Secretary scheduled the disclosed presentation; no evidence establishes knowing assistance with the secret.
